descriptions.text: Scroll of Water Breathing. Allows you to breathe underwater. Lasts as many seconds as your intelligence stat times three. It does not protect you from swimmer’s ear or being eaten by an undead barracuda. I hope you know how to swim.

recap.text: Donut pulls a Scroll of Water Breathing from her boss boxes and announces that cats do not swim. When the water hits, she sinks unconscious and bleeding, and her scroll lasts over two and a half minutes to Carl's 54 seconds. Carl paddles her out in a kayak, vomits brown water when his scroll runs out, and a bronze I'm Wet box brings ten more scrolls each. Against Lusca, he takes a scroll before turning the portal.

Louis's ribcage is held open while new organs from a full naiad's body go in, and Carl worries she breathes only water. Mordecai sews a rebreather into the bronchial, then casts a Water Breathing scroll on Louis, since Katia's potion cooldown is too long now. He connects tubes from the organs to the forming gills, and Bucket Boy jams stops into the slits. Louis coughs water from his neck; Bucket Boy pulls the stops out, and the gills remain.

beats.headline: Cats do not swim
beats.text: Among Donut's boss boxes is a scroll that fills Carl with dread: a Scroll of Water Breathing. I am a cat, Donut announces the moment she gets it; cats do not swim, cats do not go in water. Katia receives several more of the scrolls along with antidote potions, making them this floor's version of the torch and the bandage, and Carl gets a handful. Sometimes things like these scrolls are a not-so-subtle hint about what is on a level, Mordecai says.
beats.gist: Carl dreads the Scroll of Water Breathing in Donut's boss boxes, while Donut insists cats do not swim.

beats.headline: Eight scrolls
beats.text: With Donut afraid of being buried alive, Carl asks how many water-breathing scrolls she has. They're called water breathing, not sand breathing, she tells him. Eight. Then the water hits, and they are sinking in the water quadrant, Donut unconscious and bleeding. Thankfully she had taken the scroll: with her intelligence it lasts over two and a half minutes. Carl's lasts 54 seconds, and he is already close to needing another.
beats.gist: Carl's water-breathing scroll lasts 54 seconds; Donut's, thanks to her intelligence, lasts over two and a half minutes.

beats.headline: Brown water
beats.text: Carl pops a kayak from the flying house's garage onto the surface, lifts Donut in and paddles. His water-breathing scroll runs out, and he vomits dark, brown water he had not known was in his lungs; it feels like being kicked in the stomach while breathing fire. A moment after, Donut vomits too, far more water than seems possible. A bronze I'm Wet box, for more than sixty seconds fully submerged, brings ten more scrolls for each of them.
beats.gist: Carl paddles Donut in a kayak, vomits brown water when his scroll expires, and earns ten more scrolls.

beats.headline: Everyone take a scroll
beats.text: Lusca's babies are dead, but oxygen is running low and the AI complains they are just sitting there being boring. They have to go out there. Everyone take a scroll, Carl says, and takes theirs before he turns the portal and water flows in around the seal. When the boss lies dead on the ocean floor, he clicks another. Ashore, though out of the water, he takes one more to stave off the vomiting that would incapacitate him.
beats.gist: Carl has everyone take Water Breathing scrolls underwater, then takes more after the boss dies and ashore.

beats.headline: Gills that stay
beats.text: Louis's ribcage is held open while new organs go in, taken from the body of a full naiad, which has Carl worried she breathes only water. Mordecai sews a rebreather into the bronchial, then casts a Water Breathing scroll on Louis, the scroll version because Katia's potion cooldown is too long now. As the gills form, he connects tubes from the new organs to them, and Bucket Boy jams stops into the slits to keep them there after the water breathing ends. Louis coughs water from his neck. Bucket Boy pulls the stops out. The gills remain.
beats.gist: Louis gets gills: Mordecai sews in a rebreather, casts Water Breathing, and Bucket Boy props the slits open.
